name: berth-plugin-codex
description: OpenAI's coding agent for berth machines.

features.label: Codex
features.description: OpenAI's coding agent, from npm. The version is `devbox_codex_version` in the profile's ansible_vars. Adds its sign-in to the overview.
features.summary: Codex (`codex`). Being installed does not mean signed in: `codex login status` tells.

actions.name: status
actions.label: Codex sign-in
actions.help: Whether Codex is signed in for the agent account. Part of "Show who is signed in".
actions.run: echo '── Codex'; codex login status 2>&1; echo

actions.name: login
actions.label: Sign in to Codex
actions.help: Runs codex login --device-auth on the host as the agent. It shows a link and a one-time code: open the link in your own browser and enter the code.
actions.run: env -u DISPLAY -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY BROWSER=echo codex login --device-auth; echo; codex login status

actions.name: update
actions.label: Update Codex
actions.help: Bring Codex to its latest version from npm. Part of Update. The version in the profile is the least one; a newer one stays when the configuration is applied again.
actions.run: echo; echo '── Codex'; npm install --global --prefix "$HOME/.local" --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel error @openai/codex@latest && codex --version
